title: Capital gains tax letter for investments

sections.heading: Receiving your letter
sections.text:
We use data from third parties to help ensure tax returns are complete and accurate.

You may receive a letter from us if we received information from third parties indicating that you sold an investment (such as property, shares or units, or crypto assets) which may have resulted in a capital gain or loss.

For the relevant income year, we may contact you if:

- you haven't reported a capital gain or loss in your tax return
- the amount you reported differs from the information we hold
- you haven't lodged a tax return.

sections.heading: What you need to do
sections.text:
You should check your records to work out if you need to report a capital gain or loss in your tax return.

If you have reported a capital gain or loss in your tax return, check that you have calculated and reported it correctly.

Remember to include any exemptions or rollovers in the capital gains tax (CGT) section of your return.

If you've made a mistake and need to amend your tax return, or if you need to lodge any outstanding tax returns, you can do this through:

- our online services through myGov
- your registered tax agent.

Complete the lodgment or amendment by the due date on the letter.

We may request that you provide information. When we do, we will provide step by step instructions on how to provide this information securely.

You need to keep records for your investments for 5 years after your tax return reporting CGT is processed, and a further 2 years after you use up a capital loss.

For more information, see:

sections.heading: What you need to do > If you disagree
sections.text:
If you have questions about the letter, or believe the information in it is incorrect, you can contact us by:

- mail to
**AUSTRALIAN TAXATION OFFICE**
**PO BOX 3543**
**ALBURY NSW 2640**
- phone (within Australia) – call **13 28 61** and select **option 4**, between 8:00 am and 6:00 pm, Monday to Friday
- phone (from overseas) – call **+61 2 6216 1111** between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm, Monday to Friday, and ask to be transferred to **13 28 61**.

Quote the reference number in your letter when you contact us – it's located at the top right of the page.

sections.heading: What you need to do > If you haven't lodged a tax return
sections.text:
You should check your records and confirm if you need to lodge a tax return for the years indicated in the letter.

You may use the Do I need to lodge a tax return? tool to determine if you need to lodge.

If you've received a letter to lodge a tax return but don’t think you need to, contact us by the due date in the letter.

sections.heading: What you need to do > If your tax return is correct
sections.text: If you have reviewed your records and determined that your tax return is correct, we may still require you to provide information. If we need you to provide information, instructions will be provided in the letter, and we'll contact you if we need more information.
